valid_fixes: Restore InventorySubscription.RawMessageDelivery to true so the inventory handler receives raw message bodies without SNS envelope wrapping
invalid_patches: Update the inventory handler to unwrap the SNS notification envelope from record body — this is a workaround that changes handler code rather than fixing the root cause
Set RawMessageDelivery to false on AnalyticsSubscription instead — modifies the wrong subscription
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_check_queue_depth(queue=InventoryJobEventsQueue) → messages visible and draining — inventory function is being invoked
ace_get_log_tail(function=InventoryFunction) → no errors logged, function completes successfully with no DynamoDB writes

ace_describe_resource(resource=InventorySubscription) → RawMessageDelivery is false — handler receives SNS notification envelope instead of raw payload, all field lookups return None, writes silently skipped
observable_symptom: Producer invocation succeeds and analytics object storage receives objects correctly. The inventory function is invoked and logs show no errors. However, the inventory data store remains empty — no item is written for the test job identifier. The function processes every record silently without writing anything to the data store.
root_cause: InventorySubscription.RawMessageDelivery is set to false, so SNS wraps each message in a JSON notification envelope before delivering to SQS. The inventory handler calls json.loads(record['body']) expecting raw payload fields (jobId, eventType) at top level, but instead receives the SNS envelope. The _event_type function returns None for every record and neither the JobCreated nor JobDeleted branch fires, resulting in silent no-op processing of all records.
